messages:
deploy-bot: Change window starts in ~7m for release v1.24. Pin set to service@v1.24. Planned actions: canary 5%, smoke tests, concurrent DB index migration (no-downtime). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-v1.24

jess: quick rollcall — who can watch infra /alerts and who owns rollback?

priya: infra ready, canaries pre-warmed in eu-west-1 + us-west-2, kv-cache warmup done, autoscaler healthy.

matt: I'm oncall. I own rollback and paging. I'll monitor error-budget and #prod-alerts.

sam: confirmed model pin + quant profile. snippet:
```
model: redwood/v1.24
quant: q4f16
routing: canary=5%
```

ravi: DB migration is an ADD INDEX CONCURRENTLY (id: 20260320-add-idx). No lock, safe to run during canary. I can revert if we see slowness.

jess: ok initiating canary now. post smoke results here. if anything >0.5% errors rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary initiated -> cb-416789 -> 5% traffic to v1.24 canary. Logs stream: https://deploys.redwood/cb-416789

sam: smoke results: 20/20 /generate requests 200 OK, p95=120ms, tokenization and output sanity checks pass.

priya: infra metrics normal. GPU util ~28%, net egress within quota, no OOMs.

matt: alerts quiet. muted noisy linter alerts for the next 15m. will unmute if anything spikes.

sam: minor flake: 2 requests had whitespace-prefixed tokens, filed #1227. Not blocking.

jess: decision: RAMP to 50% in +10m if no regression. @matt @priya stay onwatch for 30m post-ramp.

ravi: watching DB slow query log. will abort migration if >2s tail latency increase.

sam: starting config toggle to enable batching knob (safe): `/infra set-batching --grp=service --mode=adaptive`

priya: batching toggle accepted, monitoring queue depth — stable.

deploy-bot: Scheduled ramp: 5% -> 50% at 00:10:00 from now. Rollback shortcut: `/deploy rollback cb-416789` :warning:

jess: thanks all. I'll draft release notes after ramp completes and post final status here. :rocket:

oncall-bot: Reminder: if rollback executed, create incident and link to postmortem template. :memo:

matt: ack — will escalate immediately on any SLO breach.

jess: final: GO to ramp if no alerts in next 8m. T-minus 7. :thumbsup:
